summary: Frontend UI verification for MVP closure package (7 features). All new UI is wired correctly with data-testids matching spec. Weather/holiday signal strip renders 14 cells with 2026-08-16 = ×1.03 (Güneşli hafta sonu tooltip) for London properties. Trust Center reason chips + D1 Compliance Principles section (2704 char content) render and toggle. PMS weekly PDF endpoint reachable from UI button (200 application/pdf 2370 bytes with %PDF magic). Chain Benchmark pool-consent-section toggles a property OFF (rows go 4→3, target removed from list, toast shown), restored ON at end (rows back to 4). Reject modal taxonomy chips are hard-coded in markup (7 chips with proper testids ai-pricing-reject-tag-{too_aggressive,too_low,event_unknown,segment_mismatch,data_wrong,strategy_conflict,other}); modal open flow could not be executed on Aldgate Flats or All Branches because the current data has 0 suggestions (Toplam Öneri 0) even after Run Scan — but the aggregation of a previously stored tag is confirmed visible in Trust Center tc-reason-tags ('Motor etkinliği bilmiyor ×1' = event_unknown). Regression: pilot Takip, Kill Switch Tatbikatı, Haftalık Rapor buttons all present.

issues: Panel is only reachable via Revenue Management → Market Robot → AI Pricing subtab; not exposed via a top-level command palette entry. The palette command 'AI pricing' (id=ai-pricing-v2) navigates to a different V2 panel, and 'AI Fiyatlama' navigates to the profit-priority pricing panel. Consider adding a direct palette entry so QA/users can jump straight to AIPricingEnginePanel.

action_items: None blocking. Optional: add a first-class command palette entry for the AI Pricing Engine (Market Robot > AI Pricing subtab) so users don't need to drill through two levels.

Live reject modal flow could not be exercised end-to-end via UI on Aldgate/All Branches (no suggestions produced after Run Scan). This is a data condition, not a UI defect — chips are hard-coded and backend already validated storage+aggregation.
critical_code_review_comments: AIPricingEnginePanel.js reject taxonomy is hard-coded inline (7 tuples). Consider extracting to a shared constant to keep in sync with backend REJECT_TAG_LABELS.
Chain Benchmark toast text 'Tesis havuz kıyasına dahil edildi' fires on any toggle (both directions). Consider distinct copy for enable vs disable for clearer UX.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (6/7 flows fully verified; reject modal chip markup verified via source, live open blocked by empty suggestions data)
